The homepage does not load more products on scroll, so use the leaderboard pages for full daily lists. On search results, the product entries are buttons rather than links, so clicking one is the way to open it.

name: PubMed
planner_tips: Search directly at https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=QUERY, using + or %20 for spaces; field tags like [Author], [Title], [MeSH Terms] work inside the term. Add filters as query parameters, for example &filter=years.2020-2024 for a year range, &sort=date for newest first, or &filter=pubt.systematicreview for review types. Individual articles open at https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/PMID/. No login is needed to search or read abstracts; a free NCBI account is only needed for saved searches and collections.
screen_tips: The search box is at the top of the results page and the sort control and filter sidebar sit above and beside the result list. Filters apply immediately when clicked, so check that the result count changes. Full text links appear on article pages as Free PMC article or publisher links in the right column, and the DOI is listed in the citation details. Titles and PMIDs are shown on each result card, and the abstract appears below the title on article pages.

name: QuickBooks Online
planner_tips: Open https://qbo.intuit.com/app/customreports to list saved custom reports, then open a saved report at /app/report/builder?rptId=sbg:<uuid>&type=user. Requires a logged-in QuickBooks Online session in the browser. Date fields follow the account locale (one tested locale used dd.mm.yyyy), so set dates in that format.
screen_tips: Set the date inputs, then click the report toolbar refresh button and wait for the text '<report name> report is ready'. Toolbar button positions shift when report width changes, so locate Export from the current screenshot. The Compact dropdown offers Compact View, Normal View, Expand All and Collapse All; Export to PDF under the Export menu opens an in-page PDF viewer modal, and its Save as PDF button opens a native OS save sheet that may be hard to operate.

name: Quora
planner_tips: Question, answer, topic and profile pages (quora.com/{Question-slug}, quora.com/topic/{slug}, quora.com/profile/{username}) render their main content without login, so open them directly. Keyword search at quora.com/search?q=... does not show results without a browser session, so search from the site's search box instead. Posting, upvoting, and following require a logged-in account.
screen_tips: Quora shows only the top few answers on a question page; scroll down and use the page's expand or more-answers controls to load the rest. Sign-in prompts may appear as overlays that hide content and need dismissing. The Follow and Upvote buttons change label or color once clicked, which confirms the action took effect.

name: RAWG
planner_tips: Open individual game pages directly at rawg.io/games/{slug}, for example rawg.io/games/the-witcher-3-wild-hunt, since search and filter parameters on rawg.io/games do not change the listed results. Game pages show ratings, Metacritic score, release date, platforms, genres, developers and publishers without needing a login. Browsing and reading require no account; a free signup is only needed for the separate API, which is not useful for a screen-based agent.
screen_tips: Search for a game with the site search box at the top of the page, then open the result that matches the expected release year. Game detail pages list the community rating and Metacritic score near the top, and the description, developers and publishers further down. Listing-page filters such as ordering and genre are applied in the page after it loads, so check the visible result list rather than assuming the URL changed it. If a game was renamed, the page may redirect to a different slug, so confirm the title shown on screen.

name: Reddit
planner_tips: Open full post pages directly at reddit.com/r/<sub>/comments/<id>/<slug>/, and share short links (reddit.com/r/<sub>/s/<hash>) redirect to the canonical post URL after loading. Private subreddits, NSFW posts and quarantined subs need the user to be logged in with an account that has opted into NSFW content. Old Reddit at old.reddit.com/r/<sub>/comments/<id>/ is a simpler layout and honors the same login session.
screen_tips: Post title and body appear at the top of the post page, and top-level comments follow below; scroll down twice to load more comments in long threads. Vote scores are abbreviated on screen (like 1.2k), so read the exact number from the post if precision matters. If an age gate or login wall appears, it blocks the content until the user logs in or enables NSFW in account settings.}

name: REST Countries
planner_tips: This site is a JSON API with no human-facing pages to browse, so there is nothing useful to open or click through in a browser. No login or API key is needed.
screen_tips: The base site is a raw JSON API, not a visual website, so a person-like agent has little to do on screen. If a page shows JSON, read the fields such as name.common, cca2, capital, and population directly from the text.

name: SEC EDGAR
planner_tips: EDGAR full-text search is at https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22phrase%22&forms=10-K, and company filing lists are reached through the company search at https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&company=NAME&type=10-K. Public company pages need no login, and filings can be opened directly from the Archives paths under https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/. Ticker lookup is easiest by searching the company name on sec.gov.
screen_tips: The site search box is at the top of sec.gov and the EDGAR company search form is on the browse-edgar page, where filing types can be picked from a dropdown. Filing rows show form type, filing date, and a Documents link that opens the main document. Search results list company names with CIKs, and clicking a name opens the company's filings table.

name: Shopify Admin
planner_tips: Shopify admin pages live under admin.shopify.com/store/<store-handle>/..., and you must be logged in to that store in the browser beforehand; if redirected to accounts.shopify.com, stop and ask the human to log in. Embedded apps such as the Knowledge Base app (admin.shopify.com/store/<store>/apps/shopify-knowledge-base/app) and Forms (admin.shopify.com/store/<store>/apps/shopify-forms, forms at /apps/shopify-forms/forms/<id>) open directly by URL, and their content sits inside an iframe. Open the app's own URL rather than navigating through the sidebar when possible.
screen_tips: Most app content is inside an iframe, so top-level page controls like the sidebar and search are not the app's buttons. In Forms, selecting a discount on the Success section overwrites the teaser title, form title, success title and success content with generic customer-facing text, so re-check those four fields before saving. Rich-text Content fields in Forms only accept edits by real triple-click and keystrokes; editing them with script leaves the character counter wrong and blocks saving. A Save button that stays disabled after text entry means the input did not register as typed text, so retype it.

name: Slack
planner_tips: Slack file permalinks look like https://<workspace>.slack.com/files/<USERID>/<FILEID>/<name>; open them in a tab where the user is already signed in to that workspace. Changing only the filename part of a permalink returns the same file, so identify files by their file ID. Viewing a Slack workspace requires the user to be signed in to that workspace.
screen_tips: The permalink page may sit on 'Redirecting…' indefinitely while it tries to open the desktop app; do not wait for it and use the web view or the file's download option instead. Files open in a viewer overlay where a download button is usually in the top-right toolbar. Confirm a download worked by checking that the file appears in the browser's downloads list or that the viewer shows the file name.

name: Smartlead
planner_tips: Open https://app.smartlead.ai/app/email-accounts to see sender accounts, and use /app/email-account/<id>/warmup to go straight to a mailbox's warmup tab (other tabs: overview, general, management, campaigns). Adding a mailbox needs a Smartlead login, and new accounts also need a verification email link to be opened in the same browser; Outlook connection additionally needs a Microsoft login for that mailbox.
screen_tips: Use Connect Mailbox, then choose Outlook by its visible provider text, since plain buttons may not be the clickable target. Warmup switches report state via aria-checked, and the random daily range is a slider whose aria-valuenow reads minimum|maximum; changing the total daily limit can reset both range ends, so set the range after editing the total. Confirm a connection by Smartlead's success message and the sender row, not just Microsoft consent, and reopen the account to verify warmup settings saved. In checkout, the card field is inside an iframe and a floating assistant box may cover payment fields; scroll the modal or dismiss it.

name: SoundCloud
planner_tips: Open track, playlist and profile pages directly by their permalink, such as soundcloud.com/{user}/{track-slug}, soundcloud.com/{user}/sets/{playlist-slug}, or soundcloud.com/{user}. Search results can be reached at soundcloud.com/search?q={terms} with the query URL-encoded. Public tracks, playlists and profiles need no login, but streaming audio and timed comments require signing in.
screen_tips: The track player sits at the bottom of the page with play/pause and a waveform you can click to seek. Search results can be filtered by tabs such as Tracks, People and Playlists near the top of the results. Some controls, like playing full audio, may prompt a sign-in dialog that needs dismissing before continuing. A track's play count and like count appear beneath its title on its page.

name: Spotify
planner_tips: Track, album, artist and playlist pages open directly at open.spotify.com/track/{id}, /album/{id}, /artist/{id} and /playlist/{id}, and search is at open.spotify.com/search?q=... with the query typed into the URL. Public catalog pages need no login, but library, listening history, playlist creation and lyrics require signing in to a Spotify account. Podcast episode pages may not show the full content without login.
screen_tips: The search box is at the top of the page, and typing a query there shows results in a dropdown or on the search results page. Play buttons are large green circles, and the track list on album and playlist pages shows a play icon on hover. Playback controls sit in the bottom bar, and a track starts playing only after its play button is clicked and the bottom bar changes to show the title.

name: Stack Overflow
planner_tips: Open question pages directly at stackoverflow.com/questions/{id}/{slug} and search at stackoverflow.com/search?q={keywords} or add tag:python inside q for tag filtering. Tag pages are at stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/{tag}, with sort via ?tab=votes or ?tab=newest. Reading questions and answers needs no login; posting, voting, and saving require signing in.
screen_tips: Sorting tabs (Newest, Active, Votes) sit above the question list, and the accepted answer shows a green check mark. Question and answer vote arrows are on the left side of each post. Search results can be narrowed by the filter menu on the results page. Voting or answering while logged out opens a login dialog, so check for that before retrying the action.

name: Steam
planner_tips: Open store.steampowered.com/app/{appid}/ for a game's store page, and store.steampowered.com/search/?term=QUERY to search by title. Mature games show an age check at store.steampowered.com/agecheck/app/{appid}/ that must be confirmed with a birth date before the store page loads. Prices shown depend on the country setting, which can be changed with the region selector at the bottom of the page. Buying or wishlisting requires a Steam login.
screen_tips: The store page shows price, discount percent and reviews near the top, with the Add to Cart and Add to Wishlist buttons on the right side. Discounted prices show the original price struck through beside the current price. The age check is a form with day, month and year dropdowns and a View Page button; choose a birth year well before the game's rating age. Success shows as a cart count in the header or a checkout page, not a popup.

name: Stripe
planner_tips: Open https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/apikeys for the current account's Test mode API keys, and https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/settings/account for account settings. Account-specific links use the form dashboard.stripe.com/{account_id}/test/... and a sandbox created during onboarding has its own account ID, so confirm which account is intended before creating products, prices, or webhooks. Logging in to the Stripe dashboard is required.
screen_tips: The account switcher is where to check which account is active, and the account ID is shown in account settings. The onboarding Business name field only changes the display name shown in the switcher, so use Settings then Business then Account details to change it, and only when the user asks. Do not assume the onboarding sandbox is the main account's Test mode; compare the account ID on the account settings page with the one you expect.

name: Substack
planner_tips: Each Substack publication lives at its own subdomain (name.substack.com) or custom domain, and post pages are at /p/{slug} under that host. Full post pages can be opened by URL directly, and cross-publication search at substack.com/search is not reliable without a login. Paywalled posts require a logged-in subscriber to read the full text, and free posts need no login.
screen_tips: Post list pages show titles with a lock or Subscribe prompt on paid posts, and the full body appears only for free posts or logged-in subscribers. Comments are in a section below the post and may need scrolling or a Load more click. A subscribe or sign-in modal can appear over the page and must be dismissed with its close button before reading.}

name: Supabase
planner_tips: Open the project home at supabase.com/dashboard/project/{project_ref} after confirming the project name and branch, or the organization page at supabase.com/dashboard/org/{organization_id}. Use the SQL Editor link in the navigation to reach the query editor. Signed-in access is required, and an older tab showing the sign-in page does not mean login failed.
screen_tips: In the SQL editor, the Editor content box only holds text near the cursor, so to replace a query click into the editor, press Select All, press Backspace, then paste the new SQL and read the rendered code before clicking Run. Check the Results panel after Run; DDL shows Success with no rows returned, and results may be cut off at about 100 rows with a visible error if a limit is hit. Use the SQL Editor navigation link rather than the similarly named top-bar button when the choice is ambiguous.Avoid editing the page's internal state; rely on visible text and results to confirm actions.

name: TaskSquad
planner_tips: Sign-in is SSO only (Google or GitHub), so the user must complete login in the OAuth popup before any dashboard page loads. Open https://tasksquad.ai/dashboard for the task inbox and https://tasksquad.ai/dashboard/agents for the agents list. Individual task threads are at https://tasksquad.ai/dashboard/<taskId>. Only owners and maintainers can create or delete agents or generate tokens; members can only view them.
screen_tips: Use the Status and Origin dropdowns above the inbox list to filter tasks, and the RefreshCw icon next to the Inbox heading to reload. To create a task, click New message, pick an agent from the Select agent dropdown, type a subject, then click Send. Agent tokens are shown only once after creation, so copy them immediately. Inbox status badges such as pending, running, and waiting_input show task progress, and a reply box appears at the bottom of a thread only when the task is waiting_input.

name: The Tech Geeks
planner_tips: Product pages live at thetechgeeks.com/products/<slug>, but slugs are long marketing titles, so find a product by searching thetechgeeks.com/search?q=<SKU> and opening the first product link. Prices are shown in AUD including GST, and no login is needed to view them.
screen_tips: Stock is unreliable on the page: many items show as available in the listing while sold out pages still display stale or inflated prices, so treat a price as unverified if the page says Sold out, which may appear near the product title or as a sold-out price label. Only trust prices on in-stock products, and cross-check a suspicious price against another AU vendor or the Ubiquiti store.

name: Thorne
planner_tips: Product pages follow the pattern thorne.com/products/dp/<slug>, so open the exact product slug directly rather than searching. A fetch-only view may show only a generic shell, so plan to confirm the product heading and SKU on the rendered page.
screen_tips: Find the ingredient section through the Ingredients Information navigation button, and use the Show More button to expand the ingredient table, then confirm aria-expanded and the visible table before reading. Serving size and servings per container sit above the table, and warnings are in a separate section. A product may show a To be discontinued notice beside disabled Out of Stock - Pre-Order buttons; treat that as a future notice and an unavailable control, not confirmed discontinuation, and do not click checkout or preorder to check availability.

name: TikTok Studio
planner_tips: Open https://www.tiktok.com/tiktokstudio/upload?from=upload&lang=en directly, always keeping the lang=en parameter. You must be logged into TikTok in the browser profile beforehand, and the video file must be on local disk (mp4, under 50MB). After submitting a scheduled post, the page should land on tiktokstudio/content.
screen_tips: If a banner says a video you were editing wasn't saved, click its Discard button near the top, then confirm with the red Discard button in the modal that follows; repeat for stacked drafts. The caption box is pre-filled with the filename, so clear it (click in it, press End, then Backspace many times) before typing, and press Escape to dismiss hashtag suggestions. Choose Schedule before the submit button reads Schedule instead of Post, and expand 'Show more' only after setting the time because it pushes the time picker out of view. The time picker is a scroll-wheel list where mouse-wheel steps change the value, and clicking its items may need a real mouse click rather than a script click; confirm success by the URL changing to the content page.

name: TradingView
planner_tips: Symbol pages open directly at www.tradingview.com/symbols/NASDAQ-AAPL/ using EXCHANGE-TICKER with a hyphen, and charts open at www.tradingview.com/chart/?symbol=NASDAQ:AAPL with a colon. Trading ideas for a symbol are at www.tradingview.com/symbols/NASDAQ-AAPL/ideas/. Charts, watchlists, portfolio and paper trading need a logged-in account; the public screener and symbol pages do not.
screen_tips: Pages are React apps that load data after the first render, so wait a few seconds before reading prices or charts. Chart screenshots may appear blank until the chart finishes drawing. Watchlist and portfolio features prompt for sign-in when used logged out.

name: Trello
planner_tips: Open https://trello.com/ while signed in and it redirects to https://trello.com/u/<username>/boards, the boards dashboard; do not use trello.com/boards, which errors for signed-in users. Boards open at https://trello.com/b/<boardId>/<slug>, and the slug is cosmetic so the 8-character boardId is what matters. Cards open at https://trello.com/c/<cardId>/<n>-<slug>. The site expects a signed-in session; if logged out, the marketing home page appears instead and a login is needed.
screen_tips: Board lists are side-by-side columns that scroll horizontally, and cards stack vertically inside each list. Lists and cards can take a second or two to fill in after the page looks loaded, so wait until cards appear before reading the board. The dashboard lists each board in both recent and starred sections, so pick one entry per board. Sidebar headings such as plan names are not list names; read list titles from the column headers only.

name: Trustpilot
planner_tips: Open company reviews directly at https://www.trustpilot.com/review/{domain}, for example trustpilot.com/review/amazon.com. Add filters as query parameters: stars=1 to 5 for one star rating, languages=en (default) or languages=all for every language, and verified=true for only invitation-verified reviews. Reviews are paginated with page=N, but only pages 1 to 10 (about 200 reviews) show content. No login is needed to read reviews.
screen_tips: The company's trust score and review count appear at the top of the company page. Star and language filters are in the sidebar, and the verified filter often leaves only a handful of reviews for large companies. Sorting by recency, highest or lowest rated works in the browser, so use the sort control rather than a URL parameter. Past page 10 the review list comes back empty, so stop paging there.}

name: Vercel
planner_tips: Open https://vercel.com/<team> for the team overview and https://vercel.com/<team>/<project> for a project; the Production Deployment card on the overview shows the live commit and domain, and the project's Analytics and Observability > Edge Requests pages hold traffic data. Use an existing tab in the intended logged-in Chrome profile and verify the visible account name before reading data, since a 404 on a team route can mean the wrong account. Deployment logs are at /<team>/<project>/<deployment-id-without-dpl_-prefix>/logs for runtime requests, and build logs appear in the deployment's Build Logs section. The /dashboard URL redirects to /<team>.
screen_tips: Do not open fix or remediation workflows from an Action Required banner; just read the warning and its link. Do not click Redeploy, Update or Rotate without user authorization. Analytics shows an Enable button and Demo Data label when visitor analytics is off, so the chart is sample data then. Edge Requests may appear both as a sidebar link and a card link, and client-side navigation can briefly show the previous page, so check the URL and page heading after clicking; the Build Logs list only renders visible rows, so scroll it to see all lines.

name: Walmart
planner_tips: Open search results directly at https://www.walmart.com/search?q=KEYWORDS, adding &sort=price_low, &sort=best_seller or &sort=customer_rating to reorder, and &min_price=N&max_price=N to filter by price; add &page=N for later pages. Category browsing uses /browse/ paths, and product pages are https://www.walmart.com/ip/ANYSLUG/ITEMID. Browsing and searching do not require a login, but cart and checkout do.
screen_tips: Search results mix sponsored items with organic ones, so check for a Sponsored label when choosing a product. Sort and filter controls sit above the product grid, and pagination is at the bottom of the page. Prices, ratings and stock status appear on each product card and on the product page. If a Robot or human challenge page appears, the site is blocking automated access and the task may need a different approach.

name: Wayback Machine
planner_tips: To see archived copies of a page, open https://web.archive.org/web/*/example.com (replace the URL) to get a calendar of captures, or open https://web.archive.org/web/{YYYYMMDDHHMMSS}/{url} for a specific date. No login is needed. Captures can be filtered by date using the calendar view rather than programmatic queries.
screen_tips: The archived page shows a Wayback toolbar at the top with a date selector and calendar; click a highlighted date in the calendar to jump to that capture. Pages may load slowly, so wait for the content to render before reading it. Some dates show no capture, so pick a dated bar in the calendar instead.  If a snapshot looks wrong, check the timestamp shown in the toolbar to confirm which capture you are viewing.

name: Weather APIs
planner_tips: This guide covers weather data APIs rather than interactive sites, so there are no pages to browse. Open wttr.in/CityName?format=j1 for a quick current conditions and 3-day forecast in one page. Open-Meteo offers longer forecasts up to 16 days and needs no login. weather.gov forecasts are US-only and need a city's coordinates first. No login is required for any of these services.
screen_tips: The guide is written for scripts and does not describe any on-screen controls. A person-like agent should not use a browser for these APIs because they return raw JSON or text. If a page appears as HTML or ASCII art instead of data, the wrong format parameter was used. weather.gov may reject requests without a descriptive user agent.

name: Jinjiang WeHotel
planner_tips: Open https://www.bestwehotel.com/HotelSearch/?checkinDate=YYYY-MM-DD&checkoutDate=YYYY-MM-DD&cityCode=AR04567&cityName=%E4%B8%8A%E6%B5%B7&queryWords=&extend=1,2,0,0,0,0 for Shanghai results, using lowercase checkinDate and checkoutDate. Hotel detail pages use https://www.bestwehotel.com/HotelDetail/?hotelId=JJ1888&checkInDate=YYYY-MM-DD&checkOutDate=YYYY-MM-DD with capitalized parameter names, and a wrong capitalization silently shows default dates. Browsing list and detail pages works without logging in.
screen_tips: The search button on the homepage is a div with the text 搜索, and clicking it loads results after a few seconds. Each hotel card has a 查看详情 link that opens the detail page, where the room table lists room type, breakfast, cancellation policy, and price with a 立即预订 button. Homepage dates shift daily, so set the check-in and check-out dates explicitly before searching. The text 价格区间 near the filters is a UI label, not a price.

name: Wellfound
planner_tips: Open company profiles directly at wellfound.com/company/{slug} and job boards at wellfound.com/jobs; company job lists are at wellfound.com/company/{slug}/jobs. Filtering by role or location through URL query parameters does not work reliably, so load /jobs and use the on-page filter dropdowns instead. Company overview pages are viewable without logging in, but individual job details and user profiles show a sign-in modal and need an account.
screen_tips: Wait several seconds after the page loads, since a bot-check overlay may still be resolving. If the title says Just a moment or the page is blank, wait longer before acting. Company names appear in the main heading and the description sits below it. A sign-in modal can appear over job details; close it with its close button or the Escape key to continue browsing.

name: WeRead
planner_tips: Open https://weread.qq.com/web/category/newbook for the New Book ranking, https://weread.qq.com/web/category/rising or https://weread.qq.com/web/category/hot_search for other rankings, and https://weread.qq.com/web/bookDetail/{BOOK_ID} for a book's detail page. Reader pages use https://weread.qq.com/web/reader/{BOOK_ID}k{CHAPTER_HASH} and open directly at that chapter. Reading features require logging in with WeChat by scanning a QR code on the home page https://weread.qq.com/, and the login then persists in the browser.
screen_tips: Login is a QR code shown on the home page that must be scanned with the WeChat mobile app; the page redirects to home when the scan succeeds. In the reader, the Chinese button labeled 下一章 (next chapter) sits at the bottom of the page and must be scrolled into view before clicking. When a book ends, a 全书完 or 已读完 notice appears with a 标记读完 or 标记已读 button to mark it finished. Scrolling down about 100px at a time with a pause of several seconds reads the text steadily.

name: World Bank Open Data
planner_tips: The site is a public REST API with no login needed; the human-facing data portal is at data.worldbank.org, and indicator pages there can be opened by ID. Country pages use ISO2 codes, such as data.worldbank.org/country/us for the United States. Multiple countries are chosen by semicolon-separated codes in the path, and dates and filters go in the query string, so plan for those pages rather than API calls.
screen_tips: Use the Indicator or Country selectors on data.worldbank.org to pick a series, then the Table or Chart tab to read values. Latest years often show blank cells because the data is not yet published, so look back a year or two for values. The Download button exports CSV or Excel for the current selection.

name: X (Twitter)
planner_tips: Open https://x.com/i/flow/login rather than https://x.com/ to get the full sign-in form, and ask the user for credentials instead of guessing them. Google one-click sign-in cannot be automated, so ask the user to click it themselves. After login the home feed is at https://x.com/home. A public post's article card may redirect anonymously to a login page, so do not treat that as the post being private; if the author's canonical external article link is recoverable from the public post or their cross-posted page, open that link directly, otherwise report the X Article body as inaccessible.
screen_tips: The inline home composer's Post button is the one at the bottom of the feed box, while a Post button in a pop-up compose dialog is a different control, so use the one that matches the surface that opened. If a Grok side panel appears unexpectedly, click a neutral area like the left sidebar to dismiss it before typing. A successful post shows a toast reading Your post was sent. at the bottom of the page. On a LinkedIn cross-post, a sign-in modal may cover the page while the post text and links are still visible behind it; read the visible links and do not enter credentials there.

name: Xiaohongshu
planner_tips: For searches, open https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=<url-encoded keyword>&source=web_explore_feed directly instead of typing in the home search box. To sort by latest, the results page has no top-level latest tab; the sort is under the 筛选 control, so the agent must open the filters and pick 最新. Raw links like https://www.xiaohongshu.com/explore/<id> often redirect to an app-only gate, so open posts by clicking a result card from search results, which keeps the xsec_token needed for reopening. Logging in is not described as required for search results, but some sessions may hit a login wall.
screen_tips: The 筛选 button sits in the upper-right of the results header; open it to find the 排序依据 section, where 综合, 最新, 最多点赞, 最多评论 and 最多收藏 are listed. Choose the visible 最新 pill inside that section, since duplicate hidden copies of the label exist, and the 筛选 button changes to 已筛选 when latest sort is active. After choosing it, wait for the skeleton placeholders to give way to refreshed results. Pressing Enter in the search box does not always run the search, so confirm the URL changed to search_result or the result grid updated.

name: YouTube
planner_tips: Open watch pages as https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID, and search with https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=QUERY. Channels open at youtube.com/@handle or youtube.com/channel/CHANNEL_ID. Public videos, search, and channels need no login; age-restricted or login-gated videos require signing in.
screen_tips: After the page loads, wait a few seconds before using controls because the player and metadata hydrate late. To read a transcript, expand the description with the Expand control, then click Show transcript and wait for the transcript panel to appear on the side. Ignore hidden duplicate buttons and click only visible ones. Auto-generated captions can misspell names, numbers, and technical terms, so verify those against the timestamped transcript.

name: Zillow
planner_tips: Search pages work directly: use https://www.zillow.com/homes/San-Francisco,-CA_rb/ for for-sale listings, /san-francisco-ca/rentals/ for rentals, and /san-francisco-ca/sold/ for recently sold homes. Pagination adds /2_p/, /3_p/ to the search URL, and filters are path segments like /homes/3-_beds/ or /homes/for_sale/San-Francisco,-CA/0-1800000_price/. Individual /homedetails/ property pages are often blocked by a bot wall, so plan for listing-level data from search results, and check each page before relying on it. No login is needed to view search results.
screen_tips: Property detail pages may show a captcha or block page instead of listing content; if that happens, do not rely on that page and consider a syndicated listing site with the same photos. Search results show price, beds, baths, and address on each card, and clicking a card opens its detail page. Price and status labels vary by tab: for-sale, rentals, and sold each show different fields on the cards.
